text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (The level here is so high...! So this is a GⅠ...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: But—!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(On this stage where all eyes are upon me!
I made my mark and showed my strength!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Without lacking anything, in a form worthy of admiration!
Then this time for sure—)

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text: That big sister in black is scary...

text_block_list.name: Blonde Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't Fenomeno that Umamusume
who went totally beast mode in her debut race?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Golshi's classmate!
I bet their post-race performance
is gonna be super flashy too, right!?
(Woooooah!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (...The fact that I can't break through is because I'm still too inexperienced.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Don't lose heart, me.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for your support!
Please excuse me!!

text_block_list.name: Blonde Spectator
text_block_list.text: Hm? It's kind of... ordinary?

text_block_list.name: Spectator with a Hat
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Huh...?
And here I thought she'd be way more fun~.

text_block_list.name: Spectator with a Backpack
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...!
How wonderful...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator with a Backpack
text_block_list.text: "Fenomeno"-san, huh...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno-san!
Could we get an interview?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "A comment for our magazine, please! Would it be alright if we film a video alongside it?!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Not a problem at all!
Could we start with questions from the left, please?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I want to talk to everyone as much as time allows!
So please, one at a time!
A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me. The two of you have received a message from an elementary school teacher.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Yes. This will be a major event for Fenomeno-san. Please listen closely.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh,
What would that entail, sir...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
What a surprise!
They would like to invite Fenomeno as a guest for the Children's Traffic Safety Workshop!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Apparently, 'Fenomeno-san was extremely impressive
on the racetrack.'"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "That day, I started taking an interest, and after watching interview videos, I was deeply touched by Fenomeno-san's sincerity."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"We made this request hoping this person
could serve as a role model
for the elementary school kids."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: There are people watching after all, Meno!
There are people watching, you know, Meno!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So, are you willing to accept
this offer?
choice_data_list: Of course you'll accept, right, Meno!
Of course you'll accept, won't you, Meno!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: By all means! Please do!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Children's Traffic Safety Class" is in early February... got it.
............

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!
I can finally do something for the children...!!

Seeing her smile like that,
I can't help but smile back.

She's such an earnest, good girl.
Honestly, it wouldn't be surprising if the whole nation adored her.
choice_data_list: (The momentum is with me right now—this is my chance!!)

text_block_list.text: If she wins the race that all umamusume and children dream of, she will ascend even further—!
choice_data_list: Meno, how about aiming for the Japanese Derby?
Meno, why don't we aim for the Japanese Derby?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
ââ!!
The Derby, sir?!

The Nippon Derby is a once-in-a-lifetime grand race
that everyone in the racing world
longs for with all their heart.
choice_data_list: If you win there, everyone will look up to you.
If you win there, everyone will look up to you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Roger that!!
"Hearing that answer, I spread out the materials I had prepared for her."
choice_data_list: Then next year we'll kick things off with the Aoba Sho.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—!
That race has the same conditions as the Derby...!

The Aoba Sho is a 2400m race held at Tokyo Racecourse.
Both the venue and distance match the exact conditions of the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "...Ghh, I will win! Boss!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "Win the prep race, and eventually conquer the Derby! I will accomplish that mission!"

And so, we decided on the Aoba Sho as our next target,
and the Japan Derby as our ultimate goal.
